contract.section: Frontages du Site et contexte de voisinage

coordinates.space: Pascal Site-polygon and world coordinates through read-only boundary, Terrain and frontage adapters

humanApprovals.decision: Keep topology, PLU, macro terrain, Pascal primitive assembly and BufferGeometry generation authoritative in TypeScript/CPU; use BatchedMesh for varied house shells, InstancedMesh for exact repetitions, and WebGPU/TSL only for bounded visual enrichment. Compose through the public viewerSceneSlot and make only the minimal editor change needed for Preview visibility.

Build the plugin one red-green-visible slice at a time. Adam owns consequential topology, terrain, PLU, shell and TSL mechanisms; the agent owns contracts, fixtures, boilerplate, diagnostics and evidence capture.

Use the Pascal Site polygon as the authoritative boundary. Each polygon segment can be selected as a frontage with no road, a secondary road or a primary road, and a presentation-only Streetscape corridor can be juxtaposed outside that segment to separate the active property from nearby derived properties. Keep access crossings independent from road separation. Use world-coordinate chunks and distance-to-boundary fields for continuous terrain, vegetation and LOD; use only a small derived neighbor band for immediate property relationships. Deliver open-meadow and woodland-edge before the optional Sims-like suburb extension; generated houses and PLU remain deferred.

Build one red-green-visible concept at a time. Adam owns polygon/frontage geometry, deterministic fields, terrain transitions, population grammar, TSL behavior and perceptual acceptance; the agent owns contracts, fixtures, scaffolding, diagnostics, repetitive integration and evidence capture.

Time-box a runtime-only blocky suburb demonstrator after the frontage selector: a disposable presentation root, one frontage-driven road/property band, and a few deterministic low-poly house shells. Keep neighbor elevation flat for the first proof and defer the layered Site collar, landform noise, road profile and property levels. Try optical concealment only after geometry reads; the active Site, author geometry, gizmos and overlays must remain sharp, and distance haze is the fallback if no clean viewer-owned selective DOF seam fits the timebox.

Configure every Site edge with an explicit native selector for no road, secondary road or primary road; do not cycle states through repeated edge clicks. Orient the complete mini-plan with Pascal's public camera azimuth and floorplan convention where world -Z is screen-up at north alignment.

Use Streetscape as the sole visual and procedural authority for suburban roads. Environment owns frontage-to-centerline placement and disposable lifetime only; it must not evolve competing cross-sections, materials, junctions or markings.

Do not patch node_modules or deep-import Streetscape internals. Until Streetscape exposes a public pure presentation seam, duplicate only the minimal straight-road values and functions locally, pin their provenance to commit 1c04ec9ccb3fa8124ec56dfc1026567cbbc51aef, forbid junctions, markings and regional packs, and delete the snapshot when that seam exists.

For the late-evening session, let the agent implement bounded, tested and reversible production slices while Adam performs only simple visual acceptance or requests concrete adjustments. Defer cold probes, mathematical derivations and explain-backs; agent-authored code is not learner evidence.

Do not suppress the connection between adjacent selected road frontages. Match Streetscape's degree-two bend language by deriving a tangent bend centerline in Environment and feeding one merged straight-to-bend-to-straight alignment into the pinned cross-section/ribbon snapshot for compatible styles. Keep the old miter/bevel patch as 2D topology only; do not copy the degree-three-plus junction solver, exact mixed-style transitions, markings or regional packs.

warnings: Fast-track E0-E2D implementation is automated-green: 13/13 focused road tests and 116/116 Environment tests pass, Environment and Editor host typechecks pass, and the exact Next/Turbopack production build compiles with only the known MCP dynamic-filesystem tracing warning. Human visual acceptance of the corrected bend, presentation-root isolation and WebGPU lifecycle fix remains open before E3.

Project-scoped persistence for presentation-only presets, seeds and frontages has no public host sidecar; Site polygon segments also have no stable IDs, so frontage selection must remain runtime-only in the first slice.
The existing viewerSceneSlot is currently omitted from Preview, Studio, capture and first-person paths.

The local road-presentation compatibility snapshot is pinned to Streetscape commit 1c04ec9ccb3fa8124ec56dfc1026567cbbc51aef and can drift when Streetscape changes. Do not extend it beyond the copied presets, cross-section bands, material rhythm and pure ribbons; delete it when a public pure presentation seam exists.
Secondary road maps to local-street. Collector is only a provisional primary-road candidate and still requires human visual acceptance.

Adjacent same-style frontages now merge into one degree-two bend alignment before ribbon generation. Mixed primary/secondary corners still use a separate provisional primary connector; exact transitions, degree-three-plus junctions and markings remain deferred to a public Streetscape presentation seam.

Transient road geometry and materials now use R3F's deferred disposal lifecycle after an immediate manual cleanup produced an uncaptured WebGPU missing-vertex-buffer error during remount. Confirm visually after a full refresh that the error no longer recurs.

Pascal's viewer owns a custom WebGPU/TSL RenderPipeline but exposes no generic DOF or Site-protection mask. Standard depth DOF cannot guarantee sharpness across the full active Site; use a viewer-owned selective seam or retain distance haze as the evening fallback.
